# Recipes

A recipe fills in a target for a known app from a few parameters: its folders, database dumps, excludes and hooks. See [Configuration](../configuration.md#recipes) for how to use one and how to add your own.

| Recipe | What it backs up | Guide |
|---|---|---|
| `affine` | AFFiNE self-hosted (docker compose). Uploaded blobs, config and the Postgres database. | [affine.md](affine.md) |
| `caddy` | Caddy reverse proxy (docker compose). Caddyfile and compose file; optionally the certificates. | [caddy.md](caddy.md) |
| `compose-postgres` | A self-written app in docker compose with one Postgres database and optional data folders. | [compose-postgres.md](compose-postgres.md) |
| `eichhorn-config` | Eichhorn's own configuration folder (eichhorn.yaml, repositories.yaml, targets, own recipes), from this computer. | [eichhorn-config.md](eichhorn-config.md) |
| `immich` | Immich photo library (docker compose). Originals, uploads and profiles plus a pg_dumpall of the database. | [immich.md](immich.md) |
| `nextcloud` | Nextcloud (docker compose, official image). User files, config and the database, in maintenance mode. | [nextcloud.md](nextcloud.md) |
| `static-site` | A static website (a folder of files). | [static-site.md](static-site.md) |

## `affine`

AFFiNE self-hosted (docker compose). Uploaded blobs, config and the Postgres database.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compose_dir` | yes |  | Folder with AFFiNE's docker-compose.yml and .env |
| `upload_location` | yes |  | UPLOAD_LOCATION from AFFiNE's .env, as an absolute path (default in AFFiNE is ~/.affine/self-host/storage) |
| `config_location` | yes |  | CONFIG_LOCATION from AFFiNE's .env, as an absolute path (default in AFFiNE is ~/.affine/self-host/config) |
| `db_container` |  | `affine_postgres` | Name of the Postgres container |
| `db_name` |  | `affine` | Database name (DB_DATABASE) |
| `db_user` |  | `affine` | Database user (DB_USERNAME) |

## `caddy`

Caddy reverse proxy (docker compose). Caddyfile and compose file; optionally the certificates.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compose_dir` | yes |  | Folder with Caddy's docker-compose.yml and Caddyfile |
| `data_dir` |  |  | Caddy's /data folder on the host (certificates; Caddy can also fetch them again) |

## `compose-postgres`

A self-written app in docker compose with one Postgres database and optional data folders.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compose_dir` | yes |  | Folder with the app's docker-compose.yml and .env |
| `db_container` | yes |  | Name of the Postgres container |
| `db_name` | yes |  | Database name |
| `db_user` |  | `postgres` | Database user |
| `db_password_env` |  |  | Environment variable in the container that holds the password, if needed |
| `data_dirs` |  |  | Further folders to back up (uploads, …); each becomes data-1, data-2, … |

## `eichhorn-config`

Eichhorn's own configuration folder (eichhorn.yaml, repositories.yaml, targets, own recipes), from this computer.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

## `immich`

Immich photo library (docker compose). Originals, uploads and profiles plus a pg_dumpall of the database.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compose_dir` | yes |  | Folder with Immich's docker-compose.yml and .env, e.g. /srv/immich |
| `upload_location` | yes |  | The UPLOAD_LOCATION from Immich's .env, as an absolute path, e.g. /srv/immich/library |
| `db_container` |  | `immich_postgres` | Name of the Postgres container |
| `db_user` |  | `postgres` | Database user (DB_USERNAME in .env) |
| `include_thumbs` |  | `false` | Also back up thumbnails and transcoded videos (Immich can regenerate them) |
| `stop_server` |  | `false` | Stop the Immich server during the backup, for a fully consistent copy |
| `server_container` |  | `immich_server` | Name of the Immich server container (used with stop_server) |

## `nextcloud`

Nextcloud (docker compose, official image). User files, config and the database, in maintenance mode.

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compose_dir` | yes |  | Folder with Nextcloud's docker-compose.yml, e.g. /srv/nextcloud |
| `data_dir` | yes |  | Nextcloud's data folder on the host, e.g. /srv/nextcloud/html/data |
| `config_dir` |  |  | Nextcloud's config folder on the host, if it is not inside compose_dir |
| `app_container` | yes |  | Name of the Nextcloud app container (runs occ) |
| `db_container` | yes |  | Name of the database container |
| `db_type` |  | `postgres` | postgres or mysql (also for MariaDB) |
| `db_name` |  | `nextcloud` | Database name |
| `db_user` |  | `nextcloud` | Database user |
| `db_password_env` |  |  | Environment variable in the database container that holds the password (e.g. MYSQL_PASSWORD); usually not needed for Postgres |

## `static-site`

A static website (a folder of files).

| Parameter | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | yes |  | The web root, e.g. /srv/sites/example.org |
| `name` |  | `site` | Folder name in the snapshot (useful when a target has several sites) |
